_comment: CW single-track 316L calibration. Thermophysical params calibrated ONCE, shared across ALL cases; only process params (P, v, radius) and geometry differ per case. Edit ranges/budget here. Two validation cases with different energy density improve parameter identifiability.

objective._comment: Per-case error = mean(|depth_err|, |width_err|, |ar_err|). AR = meltPoolDepth / meltPoolWidth. The aspect-ratio term penalizes compensating errors (e.g. depth+10% & width−10% fools plain mean-abs). Candidate objective = mean over all cases + physicsPenalty. Lower is better.

optimizer._comment: Bayesian optimization (Optuna TPE). nSamples = total candidate budget (48 parameter sets). Each candidate can run BOTH validation cases, so the solver-run budget can be up to nSamples × number of cases. First initSamples (16) are a Latin-Hypercube design for exploration; after that the TPE surrogate proposes where melt-pool error is likely lower. Proposals stream in batches up to maxParallel (constant-liar keeps a batch diversified). Lower objective is better.

parameters._comment: Shared 316L thermophysical knobs. Solid cp/kappa have narrow ranges (well-known from DSC); liquid values are direct at Tliquidus=1723K (uncertain). Marangoni derived: sigma × dSigmadT_norm (physically coupled). Wiedemann-Franz penalty prevents unphysical kappa_liq > L·T/ρ_elec combinations.

cp_solid_scale._note: Multiplicative on solid cp table (T ≤ Tsolidus=1658K). Solid cp well-known from DSC (±3%).

kappa_solid_scale._note: Multiplicative on solid kappa table (T ≤ Tsolidus).

cp_liquid_value._note: cp at Tliquidus=1723K. Set directly (not scaled from solid).

kappa_liquid_value._note: kappa at Tliquidus=1723K. Must satisfy WF: k_liq ≤ L·T/ρ_elec (penalized if violated).

cp_liquid_slope._note: Narrow: ±28 J/kg/K at Tvap (±3.5% of nominal 790).

kappa_liquid_slope._note: Narrow: ±7 W/m/K at Tvap (±26% of nominal 26.9).

dSigmadT_norm._note: Normalized dσ/dT = (1/σ)(dσ/dT). Marangoni_Constant = sigma × dSigmadT_norm. Literature for 316L: |dσ/dT|/σ ≈ 2-3×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹.

physicsPenalty._comment: Wiedemann-Franz correlation constraint: penalizes when optimizer picks BOTH high elec_resistivity (less absorption → shallower pool) AND high kappa_liquid (more conduction → deeper pool). These compensate in error but are physically contradictory — same scattering mechanisms that increase ρ MUST decrease κ. Expected κ at given ρ = κ_ref × (ρ_ref/ρ) + 10. weight=0.05 means worst violation adds ~0.01 to objective (typical case error ~0.05-0.20).

geometry._comment: Common geometry constants in metres. Per-case y/z extents computed from these + process/target.

cases.name: case_P200_v1200
cases._exp_rows: Hofmann row 161: P=200W v=1200mm/s d=0.05mm bare plate. Lower energy density → conduction-dominated, improves identifiability.

earlyAbort._comment: Abort once melt-pool STABILIZED (rel change last two points < stabilityTol) AND error > 50%. If case0 > 50% off, skip case1 for that candidate.

cleanup._comment: Disk saver: keep ONLY the best-so-far candidate's full data (VTK + processor*/). When a candidate completes with a lower objective it becomes the new best and the previous best is stripped; every non-best candidate is stripped as soon as it finishes. The tiny post-processing CSV, logs and case_build.json are always kept, so scoring is unaffected.

execution._comment: maxParallel = floor(totalCores / coresPerSim) = 8 parallel sims. Override with env CALIB_TOTAL_CORES / CALIB_CORES_PER_SIM (HPC sets these via job_calibration.sh). With 2 cases per candidate, 8 parallel sims = 4 candidates running at once.
execution._watchdog: Progress-based, not wall-clock. A sim is killed only if the solver Time stops advancing: perSimStallSec (1800s=30min) with no advance once running, or perSimStartupSec (3600s=1h) with no solver output at all after launch. Slow-but-progressing sims are NOT killed.
